plan.doc_literal_usage: Instantiate IfRange and access the attribute named by the docstring: ir.datetime.
plan.argument_finding_is_false: The docstring is unambiguous that :attr:`datetime` names an attribute on IfRange. There is no alias, property, or inherited datetime member in the installed source; the implementation stores and reads self.date. While the condition itself works through date, a user following the documentation literally would try to construct or inspect .datetime and fail. Thus no credible false-positive argument exists.
